title: execline: a non-interactive scripting language
description: An alternative to shell scripting that avoids all the pitfalls of sh by using a chain-loading model. Fascinating read on Unix process semantics and minimal-tool philosophy.

title: Crafting Interpreters
description: Robert Nystrom's free book walks through building two complete interpreters from scratch — a tree-walk interpreter in Java and a bytecode VM in C. One of the best practical programming books written.

title: Beating the Beckett test in 60 lines of C
description: Chris Wellons demonstrates how to write a branchless UTF-8 decoder in C. Dense and instructive: a masterclass in bit manipulation and portable C.

title: Notes on Data Structures and Programming Techniques
description: James Aspnes's Yale course notes — a thorough, freely available reference covering C, algorithms, and data structures with clear prose and worked examples.
